create_cyclic_lr_scheduler: create a CyclicLRWithRestarts scheduler with cosine annealing policy for a PyTorch optimizer
use_triangular_policy: use a TriangularPolicy to compute learning rate scaling based on current time and restart period
use_cosine_policy: use a CosinePolicy to compute cosine annealing values for cyclic learning rate scheduling
use_reduce_max_lr_on_restart: use ReduceMaxLROnRestart callback to reduce the maximum learning rate by a ratio on each restart
use_exp_reduce_max_lr: use ExpReduceMaxLROnIteration callback to exponentially reduce the maximum learning rate over iterations
